data.rationale: FY26E: Credit cost of 52-53 bps per guidance; NIM compression to 3.10% due to Q4 rate cut impact and competitive pressures. Loan growth 14% driven by sustained momentum in commercial and business banking. CASA improvement to 44.5% as digitalization continues. Cost-to-income maintained at 53% with operating leverage. FY27E-FY30E: Gradual NIM recovery to 3.30% as CASA deepens and liability franchise strengthens. Loan growth 14-16% aligned with 1.2-1.4x nominal GDP growth and market share gains in commercial banking. CASA trajectory to 48% reflecting sustained retail franchise expansion. Credit costs normalize to 45-50 bps as asset quality stabilizes at decadal best levels. Cost-to-income improves to 47% through digital investments and scale benefits. ROA expands from 1.15% to 1.58% and ROE from 11.68% to 16.2% driven by improved profitability metrics, stable 15%+ CAR, and operating leverage. Conservative assumptions factor rate cycle uncertainties and competitive intensity in Indian banking.
